content.text: Geometry checks out — committing the lower tier.
Lintel course bridging each arch, then a dark-tan cornice band tying both rings.
Upper set-back tier: two courses of small openings on the inner ring, then a capping course.
Sound — joining the last separate pieces into one structure.
Footprint overshoots: a tie plate sticks out to x=13. Removing it and tying inside the envelope.
